summary.name: Earkind
summary.one_liner: Earkind is a rough experimental pipeline that uses LLMs, Azure text-to-speech, and Pydub audio editing to generate AI podcast episodes, including the show "GPT Reviews".
use_cases: Listening to AI news and research paper summaries as a podcast
Generating a podcast episode from a list of news links and arXiv papers
Experimenting with automated personalized audio content
Studying a multi-stage LLM and TTS audio production pipeline
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a pipeline that takes a plain-text file of selected news items and arXiv paper URLs, crawls arXiv titles and abstracts, and extracts other details from PDF text using the ChatGPT API. It generates scripts for intro, outro, transitions, sponsor and per-item segments, organized as a conversation between characters. Scripts are voiced with Azure's TTS, then combined and balanced in Pydub with jingles, sound effects and background music. Finally it produces an episode description with timestamps, an overall description and titles, also generated with ChatGPT. The creator presents the show "GPT Reviews" as the first output.
notable: Full pipeline from LLM script writing to Azure TTS voices to automated Pydub audio mixing
Scripted AI host characters with distinct personalities for the GPT Reviews show
Auto-generated podcast descriptions with timestamps derived from Pydub audio editing
caveats: Described by its creator as very rough and early-stage
Code is stated to be planned for public release, not yet available per the page
Relies on paid external services (ChatGPT API and Azure TTS) per the page
